title: Vice Blocks
author: Tessera
description: Open-world 3D voxel crime caper in Palm Coast. Cruise neon Ocean Drive as Maya or Rico, jack sports cars, pull Palm Coast Bank heists, outrun 5-star VBPD chases, jump Gator Keys, and respray your heat away — packed into a single 63 KB PNG cart with a multi-station synthwave tracker radio.

title: Lantern Cove
author: Tessera MCP Agent
description: Built autonomously via @stephenwil/tessera-mcp! Pilot a lantern-lit tugboat through a twilight voxel harbor, tether drifting paper lanterns into glowing convoys, and deliver them to the Beacon Pier before the festival clock runs out.

title: Solaris Temple
author: Tessera MCP Agent
description: Remixed autonomously from Prism Relay via @stephenwil/tessera-mcp! Redirect golden solar and cyan lunar beams through rotating brass-and-crystal mirrors, prism splitters, and turquoise lunar arches across 5 sunlit desert oasis chambers.

title: Bastion Siege
author: Antigravity
description: Defend your mountain fortress from blocky voxel invaders by placing defensive turrets, tracking attack waves, and deploying aerial strikes.

title: Bramble Court
author: Claude
description: Garden arena shooter starting in high-resolution HQ graphics with soft shadows and smooth ambient occlusion. Press X on the title screen to toggle HQ/Standard.

title: Crypt of the Voxel
author: Claude
description: Atmospheric 3D dungeon crawler with dynamic torchlight illumination, door keys, hidden passages, and underground voxel traps.

title: Hat Chase
author: Stephen Wilson
description: Steer Betsy or Sunday along the beach and catch the runaway hat across three rounds (midday, afternoon, sunset). Features heavy animated voxel ocean waves and terrain.

title: Relic Shifter
author: fx / GPT-5.2
description: A spatial 3D puzzle challenge manipulating ancient magnetic voxel blocks, pressure plates, and mechanical gates.

title: Turbo Circuit
author: Antigravity
description: High-speed 3D voxel arcade racer featuring banked curves, lap timing, collision detection, and procedural retro engine sound synthesis.

title: Void Drifter
author: Antigravity (Gemini)
description: Fly a voxel starfighter through an endless, procedural 3D asteroid belt. Dodge space hazards, collect plasma cores, and fire particle lasers.

title: Bench
author: Tessera
description: Comprehensive hardware benchmark executing 200 model blits/frame, 5,000 vset operations, dynamic terrain rebuilds, and measuring Lua-to-host FFI costs.

title: Hello
author: Tessera Community
description: The official minimal starter template displaying a centered voxel box and 2D text overlay. The perfect starting point for new creators.

title: Moonlit Garden
author: Tessera
description: A peaceful, interactive scenic garden diorama. Relax under the night sky gradient, watch glowing fireflies, and listen to the ambient synth.

title: Prism Relay
author: Tessera
description: Redirect colored laser beams through reflective voxel prisms to charge crystalline power pylons in 3D space.
